text: This bank is a hundred and five years old. It's growing like a startup.
Clue one. Tamilnad Mercantile Bank's loans grew twenty nine percent. Of twenty two banks, only two small finance banks grew faster.
Clue two. To fund it, deposits grew twenty five percent.
The twist. Eighty two of every hundred new rupees came as costlier term deposits. Cheap CASA fell from twenty seven to twenty five percent of deposits.
Fast growth, pricier fuel. Can it keep both? Back to the napkin.
